name: Asian Energy Services Ltd
title: Asian Energy Services Ltd - 530355 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 57% to INR338 crore, but management admits it missed prior FY26 guidance on timing; FY27 standalone growth 30–40% and Kuiper $60–65M rest mostly on existing INR1,750 crore order book.

capex.quote: there is no capex commitment we have for our services business or for international expansion

triggers.label: Prior FY26 guidance missed on timing
triggers.quote: the company was unable to fully meet the previously communicated guidance for the year

triggers.label: Order book INR1,750 crore ex-Kuiper
triggers.quote: robust, well-diversified order book of approximately INR 1,750 crores

triggers.label: Standalone FY27 growth 30–40%
triggers.quote: for FY '27 we hope to grow between 30% to 40%

guidance.quote: for FY '27 we hope to grow between 30% to 40%
we are looking at the top line of roughly around $60 million to $65 million
our EBITDA margins will be roughly around 12% to 13%
we are looking for reaching an Oilmax revenue of between INR800 crores to INR900 crores
targeting approximately 1,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day by FY '27
scale the business to about $100 million of revenue by FY '29
25% to 30% would be a pretty decent range, Sunny.
We are more or less on the same guidance still, Sunny.

evasions.quote: It's difficult for me to commit to a date to you today.
